name: plugin.graphiti_zep_memory_governor
description: Graphiti / Zep temporal memory governor plugin providing bi-temporal edge normalization, entropy-gated MinHash/LSH entity dedup with dangling endpoint cleanup, RRF/MMR/hop-distance reranking, weighted label propagation, and typed Zep ontology compilation
author: Brain Harness Authors

entrypoints.name: zep_normalize_bitemporal_edges
entrypoints.description: Clamp future-tense assertion valid_at dates to reference_time, filter soft deadlines, and partition contradicted vs surviving edge IDs

parameters.name: fact
parameters.description: Natural-language fact statement associated with the edge

parameters.name: reference_time
parameters.description: Statement episode ISO-8601 UTC timestamp

parameters.name: valid_at
parameters.description: Optional extracted valid_at ISO-8601 timestamp

parameters.name: invalid_at
parameters.description: Optional extracted invalid_at ISO-8601 timestamp

parameters.name: existing_edges
parameters.description: Existing candidate edges inspected for contradiction partitioning

parameters.name: contradicted_ids
parameters.description: UUIDs of edges superseded by the new fact

entrypoints.name: zep_resolve_entities_and_endpoints
entrypoints.description: Resolve extracted entities via character Shannon entropy gating, 32-perm blake2b MinHash and 4-band LSH, promote labels, and prune unreferenced materialized dangling endpoints

parameters.name: extracted_entities
parameters.description: Extracted entity dictionaries containing name and labels

parameters.name: existing_entities
parameters.description: Existing canonical entity nodes to match against

parameters.name: edge_endpoints
parameters.description: List of [source, target] pairs referenced by extracted edges

parameters.name: kept_edge_endpoints
parameters.description: Surviving [source, target] pairs after edge filtering used to prune orphan materialized endpoints

entrypoints.name: zep_rerank_hybrid_search
entrypoints.description: Rerank retrieval candidates using Reciprocal Rank Fusion (rrf), L2-normalized Maximal Marginal Relevance (mmr), or shortest-hop centrality (node_distance)

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Reranking algorithm: rrf, mmr, or node_distance

parameters.name: ranked_lists
parameters.description: Ranked UUID lists fused when method=rrf

parameters.name: query_vector
parameters.description: Dense query embedding for method=mmr

parameters.name: candidate_vectors
parameters.description: Mapping of candidate UUID to dense embedding for method=mmr

parameters.name: center_node_uuid
parameters.description: Center entity UUID pinned at 0.1 distance for method=node_distance

parameters.name: hop_distances
parameters.description: Mapping of candidate UUID to graph hop distance for method=node_distance

parameters.name: rank_const
parameters.description: Smoothing rank constant k for RRF (default 1)

parameters.name: mmr_lambda
parameters.description: Relevance vs diversity tradeoff parameter for MMR (default 0.5)

parameters.name: min_score
parameters.description: Minimum post-rerank score cutoff (default 0.0)

entrypoints.name: zep_cluster_and_compile_ontology
entrypoints.description: Cluster entity communities via edge-weighted label propagation, verify per-group sequential episode queues, and compile typed EntityModel/EdgeModel ontologies

parameters.name: neighbor_projection
parameters.description: Mapping from node UUID to neighbor dicts with node_uuid and edge_count

parameters.name: episode_batches
parameters.description: Episode batch dictionaries validated for non-empty group_id queue serialization

parameters.name: entity_schemas
parameters.description: Zep EntityModel declarations checked for docstrings, valid wire types, Identity and Excluded markers

parameters.name: edge_schemas
parameters.description: Zep EdgeModel declarations enforcing non-empty descriptions and forbidding Identity on edges
